variant.title: Numbered Rooms
variant.description: An outside clue points into a row or column. Its first cell selects the position that must contain the clue digit.
rule_guide.title: Numbered Rooms Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Read each outside clue toward the board. If the first cell is N, the Nth cell in that direction must contain the clue digit.
rule_guide.item_3: For example, a left-side clue 5 beside a row whose first cell is 4 means the fourth cell from the left is 5. Clues at opposite ends work independently.
